latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Accusation Audit Generator.

- Generate a preemptive objection audit and emotion-label bank before high-stakes conversations or negotiations.
- Collects situation details and anticipated objections to produce an accusation audit artifact.
- Converts anticipated negative emotions into neutral, third-person labels using the “It seems like…” formula.
- Sequences emotion labels from strongest to lightest, with delivery script and pause instructions.
- Designed for salespeople, founders, managers, and anyone expecting resistance or negative emotions in important conversations.
